verdict.rationale: Activepieces natively supports background automation via flows (trigger+actions), durable execution with checkpoint resume, scheduled/async triggers, and AI agents that 'handle work as it arrives' with tool access and approval gates—clearly enabling autonomous background runs. Docs also show governance (audit logs, sensitive-flow approvals) reinforcing safe autonomous operation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of long-running autonomous agent reliability beyond vendor docs and changelog claims.
